canonical_source.retrieval_method: curl --fail --location --silent --show-error --output /tmp/helix-r2-pg35-a.txt https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/35.txt.utf-8; repeated independently to /tmp/helix-r2-pg35-b.txt and compared by SHA-256
canonical_source.selection_rationale: Selected as compact public-domain English narrative prose from a different author and late-Victorian scientific register than Moby-Dick. Project Gutenberg eBook #11 was retained as out-of-corpus evaluation data rather than moved into training. Project Gutenberg eBook #1342 was considered but is substantially larger for this laptop-scale milestone. HTML and EPUB representations were rejected because markup and container structure add format-specific noise.
